method: Unchanged benchmark harnesses;20 warmups and11 timed samples, numeric compiled subset200 warmups. Native executables through Lean C backend+leanc -O2. Default and native-preference-disabled --run measured separately using same internal IO timers.

lean-run-raw.mode: ordinary Lean --run with existing precompiled standard library; imported native functions may execute natively
limits: Internal kernel timers exclude parsing/elaboration, process startup, input setup and result inspection.
Sequential single-process samples per case; no CPU isolation or confidence intervals.
Lean --run may combine interpreted local IR and precompiled imported code; not all-interpreted standard library.

lean-run-no-native-preference-raw.mode: Lean --run -Dinterpreter.prefer_native=false; extern/initializer native lookup still applies
limits: Internal kernel timers exclude startup, frontend/import, input setup and inspection.
Native preference disabled; extern/initializer native functions remain allowed.
Single machine sequential processes, no CPU pinning/confidence intervals.

limitations: Single machine, sequential cases/processes, no CPU isolation/confidence intervals; concurrent small regression testing may interfere. Raw samples show substantial variance.
These compare end-to-end equivalent kernels; native Lean specialization/mapTR and generic imported guest IR differ. Not equal-IR compiler comparisons.
Default --run permits native symbol fallback; disabling native preference still permits required extern/initializer native calls.
Kernel timers exclude startup/frontend/import, input setup, JVM thaw/freeze and result checks. JVM GC may occur inside; native destruction is after timer.
Eager JVM block compilation is distinct from adaptive/lazy resident :jvm and from the currently accepted full frontend :mutable profile.
Restricted numeric subset uses exact guarded small integers; native Nat arbitrary precision and UInt64 modular arithmetic are distinct contracts, agreeing on sampled inputs only.
No general frontend speed ratio, competitive-throughput result, SCI/CLJS comparison, or bound on future JVM performance follows.
review: Independent Astra audit of fresh ratios, source timing boundaries, full frontend backend, and Lean --run native fallback semantics.
